instructions:
## Objective

Search for short DNA sequences with high predicted regulatory activity.

## Work to perform

Implement a deterministic query-limited search around a supplied black-box model. The main call requests four 249-base sequences using at most 40,000 queries; other track and budget settings also test the interface.

## Deliverable

Committed search function returning valid sequences.

## Evaluation

Each design takes the lowest prediction from three hidden models; mean robust activity is normalized against reference anchors, with contract and budget checks.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
